My dear Cousin Mary[^1],
I am glad you like my books. I think there are one or two more that you have not seen, [the Stokesley Secret](/book/40) which is about the size of [Countess Kate](/book/44), and is most of it fun, [Kenneth](/book/10), which is about a boy and girl in the Retreat from Moscow, and some short stories for poor children, called [Langley School](/book/9), [Friarswood Post office](/book/36), [Leonard the Lion heart](/book/26) and [Ben Sylvester’s Word](/book/25)
your affectionate cousin

C M Yonge


[^1]: The letter is obviously addressed to a child, and is catalogued in the Coleridge collection at Texas. [Mary Elizabeth Coleridge](/person/350) (1861-1907) is suggested as a possibility. None of the books mentioned was published later than 1862.
